meta.name: render-cartoon-music-video
meta.description: Assemble a cartoon / animated / hand-crafted music-video ad from a config — a sung song carries the whole narrative while N per-bar i2v clips (one recurring animated character, one look pack) are each cut to their BAR window from librosa beat-tracking and hard-concatenated on the bar, VEED-whisper white bold-sans captions in the BOTTOM third (Alignment 2, above the logo bug, no pill) burned from the song's word timings re-spelled against the locked lyrics, a persistent brand logo bug held over the body (suppressed on the end card), and closed on a solid-brand-color PIL end card with the song still playing under it — never AI-rendered text. This is the FREE deterministic assembly stage (cut-to-bar + hard concat + logo bug + captions + end card + song mux); the song, character, keyframes, and clips come from create-music-elevenlabs / create-image-fal / create-video-fal. Use for the cartoon-music-video format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把歌曲和动画素材自动拼成音乐视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用歌曲和动画片段自动生成带字幕和品牌标识的音乐视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble a cartoon music video ad from song and animation clips automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically produce a branded music video ad from a song and animated clips.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据配置自动组装卡通音乐视频广告：将每小节一个的动画片段按节拍拼接，在底部添加白色粗体字幕，叠加品牌标志，最后加上纯色结尾卡片，全程不调用付费服务。
howto.when: 当你提供歌曲、歌词时间戳、节拍数据、每小节一个动画片段以及品牌标志 SVG 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这首歌和这些动画片段组装一个卡通音乐视频。
say.note: Claude 会按节拍拼接片段并添加字幕和标志。

say.text: 用这个品牌标志和结尾卡片样式渲染音乐视频。
say.note: Claude 会叠加标志并生成纯色结尾卡片。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can assemble a cartoon music video ad from a config: it cuts per-bar animation clips to beat boundaries, hard-concats them, burns white bold captions at the bottom, overlays a persistent logo bug, and appends a solid-color end card — all without paid calls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a song, word timestamps, bar data, one clip per bar, and a brand wordmark SVG.

say_en.text: Assemble a cartoon music video from this song and these clips.
say_en.note: Claude will cut clips to bars and add captions and logo.

say_en.text: Render the music video with this brand logo and end card style.
say_en.note: Claude will overlay the logo and generate a solid-color end card.
